scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of an elderly gray-bearded man in cream and rust-colored robes sitting on a woven mat in a sunlit plastered room, looking upward with one open hand raised. An earthenware jug and small oil lamp stand beside him; flat-roofed buildings and a palm are visible through the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Daniel's attentive pose imaginatively represents his reception of another vision. His age, clothing, room and warm light are artistic choices, not details specified by this verse. The light does not depict God. Belshazzar supplies the date, so he is not pictured; neither the earlier vision nor the new vision's contents are shown.
